newsitem.title: GREECE: POLL - AVG BIDS ON GREEK FRN/BOND SEEN 100.2/98.7.
newsitem.headline: POLL - AVG BIDS ON GREEK FRN/BOND SEEN 100.2/98.7.

text.p: FRNs and three-year fixed coupon bond will produce average bids
of 100.20 and 98.70, respectively, bankers, mutual fund managers
and brokers predicted in an informal poll by Reuters.
The poll participants were asked to forecast the average bid
for the FRN and the three-year bond at the auction. The results

An interesting feature of the poll was that a few mutual
fund managers said they would either not bid for the three-year
bond or they would bid for the bond only in small sums.

floaters with the benchmark 12-month T-bill set at 12 percent
for the first year and the spread set at 140 basis points over
